title: Zephyr: regional limit configuration (EU 1%, US FCC)
description: Regional duty cycle limits. AC: EU 1% and US FCC limits configurable, enforced per region.
notes: Implemented a bounded, no-allocation Zephyr HAL regional policy API with canonical EU868 1% (10 permille rolling hour) and US915 FCC (1000 permille plus 400 ms dwell) profiles. Invalid/null/unconfigured inputs fail closed; invalid initialization resets state; profile lookup is output-atomic; interval arithmetic saturates at UINT64_MAX; rolling overlap recovery and fixed record capacity are enforced. Added a strict format-v2 generator and shared-vector host/Zephyr test covering all 8 tracking vectors, exact/over dwell, rolling boundaries, u64 saturation, invalid profiles, NULL state, zero duration, and capacity reclamation. Validation: host AppleClang strict C23 + UBSan CTest 1/1 PASS; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build PASS and runtime suite 1/1 PASS / PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL; Python duty-cycle/vector tests 52/52 PASS; isolated Rust lichen-core duty_cycle_vectors 2/2 PASS; ruff and git diff --check PASS. Dirty L2 TX integration files were intentionally untouched per orchestrator; scoped regional API/tests establish this leaf and the separate tracker/integration beads consume the API.
close_reason: Canonical EU868/US915 regional profiles and fail-closed bounded enforcement implemented and validated across C, Zephyr, Python, and Rust vectors.
